text:
oncall-bot: Pager — HIGH 5xx rate for customer skyward-analytics on dedicated-cluster eu-west-2 (pool: ded-eu2-prod-6). 5xx rate: 0.2% -> 11.7% over 15m. Timeouts/504s dominant. Paging SRE rotation. Severity: Sev2. Link: https://redwood.metrics/alerts/5223334444 :rotating_light:

alex: ack — I'm on it. pulling logs and dashboards.

nina: joining. @alex any obvious capacity alerts? queue depth?

alex: dashboard shows inflight queue > 2500 (baseline 120). GPU utilization on that pool at 96%. KV eviction rate spiked for tenant skyward-analytics. suspect noisy tenant / model hot path. grabbing traces.

sam: grabbing customer request patterns — POST /v1/generate from skyward shows long tail of large seq requests (seq len ~ 8k), causing kv growth and memory pressure.

jade: repeating error snippet from router logs:
```
2026-03-15T09:12:03Z ERROR gateway request failed tenant=skyward-analytics status=504 backend=ded-node-45 msg="context deadline exceeded"
2026-03-15T09:12:04Z WARN kv evict tenant=skyward-analytics evicted_keys=128
```

kevin: suggest immediate mitigations: 1) reduce concurrency for tenant in router config 2) enable fallback small-quant model for that tenant 3) move tenant to spare nodes / reroute a subset of traffic.

alex: applying soft concurrency limit now: `curl -X POST https://admin.internal/tenants/skyward/config -d '{"concurrency_limit": 4}'` -> 202 accepted

nina: enabling fallback variant (vq2) via rollout API
```
POST /admin/models/rollout
{"tenant":"skyward-analytics","from":"gptx-16k","to":"gptx-8k-fallback","percent":100}
```
returns ok.

sam: scaling pool +2 nodes: `k scale deploy ded-eu2-prod-6 --replicas=12` (was 10). api accepted.

emily: CSM here — notifying customer with initial note: "we're investigating elevated errors, mitigation in progress, next update in 15m". cc @customer-success

10m update — errors still elevated but dropping: current 5xx ~5.1% (was 11.7%). KV evictions dropping.

kevin: observed tail latencies still high for long seq requests. still see some 504s from node-45. proposing drain node-45 and reprovision.

alex: draining node-45 now: `adminctl drain-node ded-node-45 --grace=30s` -> started. rerouting traffic.

nina: after drain, 5xx now 0.9%. queue depth down to 180. GPU util 72%.

emily: told customer we expect full recovery within 30m, they asked for root cause postmortem.

sam: root cause notes: skyward pushed a new batch of long-context requests with higher concurrency than profile; dedicated pool lacked isolation, their KV growth caused local memory pressure and evictions which cascaded to timeouts.

jade: next steps: create isolation policy (per-tenant caps on kv size), add emergency autoscale trigger on KV eviction rate, run postmortem, customer follow-up.

alex: handing off to night shift: @nina you're primary, @kevin secondary. I'll add runbook updates.

oncall-bot: incident status -> mitigated. incident tag: mitigated-5223334444. close if no regressions in 60m.
